verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Wat-toor
Wa kitaabin mastoor
Fee raqqin manshoor
Wal-baytil-ma'moor
Was-saqfil-marfoo
Wal-bahril-masjoor
Inna adhaaba rabbika lawaaqi
Maa lahu min daafi
Yawma tamoorus-samaa'u mawraa
Wa taseerul-jibaalu sayraa
Fawaylun yawma'idhin lilmukadhdhibeen
Al-ladheena hum fee khawdin yal-aboon
Yawma yuda'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'aa
Haadhihin-naarul-latee kuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
Afasihrun haadhaa am antum laa tubsiroon
Islawhaa fasbiroo aw laa tasbiroo sawaa'un alaykum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
Innal-muttaqeena fee jannaatin wa na'eem
Faakiheena bimaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum adhaabal-jaheem
Kuloo washraboo hanee'an bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Muttaki'eena alaa sururin masfoofatin wa zawwajnaahum bihoorin een
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wattaba'athum dhurriyyatuhum bi-eemaanin alhaqnaa bihim dhurriyyatahum wa maa alatnaahum min amalihim min shay'in kullu imri'in bimaa kasaba raheen
Wa amdadnaahum bifaakihatin wa lahmin mimmaa yashtahoon
Yatanaaza'oona feehaa ka'san laa laghwun feehaa wa laa ta'theem
Wa yatoofu alayhim ghilmaanun lahum ka'annahum lu'ulu'uun maknoon
Wa aqbala ba'duhum alaa ba'din yatasaa'aloon
Qaaloo innaa kunnaa qablu fee ahlinaa mushfiqeen
Famanna Allaahu alaynaa wa waqaanaa adhaabas-samoom
Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahu huwal-barrur-Raheem
Fadhakkir famaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahinin wa laa majnoon
Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihi raybal-manoon
Qul tarabbasoo fa-innee ma'akum minal-mutarabbiseen
Am ta'muruhum ahlaamuhum bihadhaa am hum qawmun taaghoon
Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal laa yu'minoon
Falya'too bihadeethin mithlihi in kaanoo saadiqeen
Am khuliqoo min ghayri shay'in am humul-khaaliqoon
Am khalaqus-samaawaati wal-arda bal laa yooqinoon
Am indahum khazaa'inu rabbika am humul-musaytiroon
Am lahum sullamun yastami'oona feehi falya'ti mustami'uhum bisultaanin mubeen
Am lahul-banaatu wa lakumul-banoon
Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloon
Am indahumul-ghaybu fahum yaktuboon
Am yureedoona kaydan fa-al-ladheena kafaroo humul-makeedoon
Am lahum ilaahun ghayru Allaahi subhaanallaahi ammaa yushrikoon
Wa in yaraw kisfan minas-samaa'i saaqitan yaqooloo sahaabun markoom
Fadharhum hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee feehi yus'aqoon
Yawma laa yughnee anhum kayduhum shay'an wa laa hum yunsaroon
Wa inna lilladheena zalamoo adhaaban doona dhaalika wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa-innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom
Wa minal-layli fasabbihhu wa idbaaran-nujoom
